item.title: Michigan seeking input on transportation safety
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) — The Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT) is asking the public to share thoughts on transportation safety in an online survey. The survey is being conducted as part of MDOT's Strategic Highway Safety Plan and Vulnerable Road User Safety Assessment. The two programs seek to advance roadway safety and reduce traffic crashes. item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) -- A burst pipe at senior living community StoryPoint East Lansing has forced dozens of residents to temporarily relocate.
